document.capturedText: Job detailsHere’s how the job details align with your profile.Job typematching preferenceFull-time LocationGurugram, Haryana Full job description Overview: About Cvent www.cvent.com Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection. AI at Cvent: Leading the Future Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you. Disclaimer:Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “[redacted-email]” email addresses. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent. If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at [redacted-email]. For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice: https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. In This Role, You Will: Cvent is seeking an exceptional senior executive to serve as its Senior Vice President / Vice President, Marketing – India. This role is the senior-most marketing leader in India. This individual will be a critical force multiplier: ensuring that India’s 200+ marketing professionals are high performing, deeply aligned with global priorities, and operating at the frontier of marketing innovation. Beyond operational stewardship, this executive will serve as a recognized champion of the Event Technology and Martech landscape — representing Cvent’s perspective externally in India & APAC/IMEA region. The role operates within a global matrix structure: functional direction flows from discipline leaders based across the US, EMEA, and APAC, while this executive holds full ownership of people leadership, operational excellence, talent strategy, and site culture for India. In This Role, You Will:: 1. People Leadership, Coaching & Talent Management Serve as the primary people leader for 200+ India-based marketing professionals across multiple disciplines, coaching and developing talent in close partnership with global functional leaders. Drive a comprehensive India marketing talent strategy: workforce planning, strategic hiring, structured onboarding, career pathing, and retention — with depth in demand generation, Martech, digital, analytics, events, and creative. Identify and accelerate high-potential leaders; build robust succession pipelines and a strong internal bench across all marketing functions. Foster a high-performance, inclusive culture aligned with Cvent’s values and spirit of intrapreneurship — where every marketer is empowered to think like an owner and act with urgency. 2. Champion of Event Technology & the Marketing Stack Act as a credible “internal customer”: represent the marketer’s perspective when evaluating Cvent’s own product portfolio and translate those insights into actionable feedback for Product, GTM, and Customer Success teams. Champion Event-Led Growth (ELG) thinking across the India organization, ensuring teams deeply understand how Cvent’s platform drives pipeline, revenue, and engagement for enterprise B2B marketers globally. Represent India marketing in global forums and industry events as a confident, opinionated voice on modern B2B marketing and Event Technology. 3. AI Transformation Champion Lead Cvent India’s AI transformation within marketing — actively monitoring best-in-class AI tool developments, enterprise adoption trends, and emerging agentic workflows across the global marketing industry. Experiment with and evaluate frontier AI platforms — generative content tools, AI-driven video automation (including Goldcast’ s capabilities), intelligent personalization, and analytics automation — bringing informed, hands-on recommendations to the organization. Partner with Global Marketing Operations to identify, pilot, and scale high-impact AI and automation use cases in India-based workstreams: content production, QA, campaign operations, and workflow automation. Build a culture of AI-first thinking: upskill teams, reduce manual effort, and enable India marketing to operate with the agility and leverage that modern AI tooling provides. Translate AI adoption into measurable outcomes — velocity, quality, cost efficiency — and report on impact in global leadership reviews with clarity and precision. 4. Operational Excellence & Follow-the-Sun Execution Own the day-to-day operational rhythm of India-based marketing teams, ensuring reliable delivery against SLAs and commitments to global discipline leaders and regional stakeholders. Design and continuously improve follow-the-sun workflows across US–EMEA–APAC time zones for campaigns, events, marketing operations, and creative services — optimizing for speed, quality, and continuity of execution. Partner with Global Marketing Operations on capacity planning, prioritization, and skills-to-work alignment, ensuring India bandwidth maps to the highest-impact global initiatives. Drive continuous improvement in processes, tooling, and collaboration models — positioning India as a recognized center of operational excellence within global marketing. 5. Stakeholder Management & Matrix Leadership Act as the primary India marketing point of contact for global discipline leaders, regional sales leadership (APAC/IMEA), and executive stakeholders across the business. Ensure clear, disciplined alignment of goals, expectations, and performance feedback between India teams and global functional counterparts. Partner with HR, Finance, Facilities, and corporate functions in India to champion site culture, employee engagement, and a world-class workplace experience for marketing professionals. 6. Governance, Brand & Compliance Ensure India marketing teams adhere to global policies and standards related to brand, security, data privacy, and event execution. Proactively manage operational and people-related risks in partnership with global functional owners. Here's What You Need:: 20+ years of progressive B2B marketing leadership within SaaS or enterprise technology organizations, with significant experience in people leadership and operations-focused roles. Demonstrated success leading large, multi-disciplinary marketing organizations of 100+ professionals in a global matrix structure, where functional ownership sits with distributed global leaders Deep, genuine familiarity with Event Technology and/or Martech landscape — as a practitioner, platform buyer, or industry advocate. Recognized credibility as a voice in this space. Ability to serve as a sophisticated “internal customer”: evaluate marketing technology with a practitioner’s lens and translate insights into actionable product and GTM feedback. A proven track record of driving AI adoption in marketing — through tooling, workflow transformation, or team capability-building — with an informed, hands-on orientation toward emerging AI platforms. Exceptional coaching, talent management, and recruiting capability: a track record of building high-performing teams, accelerating leaders, and constructing strong succession pipelines. Experience managing follow-the-sun or global delivery models, including capacity planning, workload balancing, and cross-time-zone collaboration. Outstanding stakeholder management skills — the ability to build trusted, influential partnerships with global CMO-level leaders, regional sales executives, and corporate functions. Strong working knowledge of Martech, digital marketing, and data-driven demand generation. Exposure to APAC and/or IMEA markets and regional marketing dynamics strongly preferred. Executive presence and communication excellence; comfortable representing India marketing credibly in global forums and at industry events. Master degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree strongly preferred. Why This Role This is a rare opportunity to lead one of the largest marketing organizations in India within a category-defining global technology company at a pivotal inflection point. Cvent is executing the most ambitious transformation in Event Technology history — building a Marketing-first AI-powered event management software that unifies in-person, virtual, and hybrid experiences. The executive in this role will shape how that transformation is experienced by 200+ marketers across India, establish India as the operational heartbeat of Cvent’s global marketing capability, and help attract and develop the finest marketing talent in the country.
